Self-study

Picture Speaking Self-study Pack

30 A1-A2 everyday speaking questions from two picture-card files. Translations are hidden, audio is included, and every card has a simple example answer in English.

How to study: 1) look at the picture, 2) answer the question aloud, 3) open Russian only if needed, 4) listen to the example answer, 5) mark the card as done. Humanity survived worse systems, allegedly.
